decisions.reason: The LED voltage and level-shifting choice does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change the standalone USB activation condition, LDO, current rating, or its support for the complete 3.3V rail.
The existing state already makes the addressable-LED load on the 5V boost conditional on 5V configuration; the source does not change the boost controls or capacity.
Changing how the main-board LED is powered and level-shifted does not change its charge-status function, GPIO assignment, or CHGLED connector circuit.
The conditional LED supply choice does not alter the interboard connector types, signals, or matching pin-order policy.
The source concerns the main-board status LED and does not change the separate LED board's count or addressable-array requirement.
LED supply voltage and logic-level handling do not affect the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The source does not change I2C speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series-resistor configuration.
The LED supply decision does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or net labeling.
The electrical LED choice does not change the power board's enclosure fit, connector placement, mounting holes, or dimensions.
The source does not affect the battery connector's placement, form factor, pin count, or unresolved pinout.
The LED power and level-shifting choice does not change any battery protection mode or cutoff requirement.
